import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MOD = 1000000007;

    static class Matrix {
        int[][] mat = new int[32][32];

        Matrix() {
            for (int i = 0; i < 32; i++) {
                Arrays.fill(mat[i], 0);
            }
        }

        Matrix mul(Matrix b, int k) {
            Matrix c = new Matrix();
            for (int i = 0; i <= k; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j <= k; j++) {
                    for (int l = 0; l <= k; l++) {
                        c.mat[i][l] = (int) ((c.mat[i][l] + (long) this.mat[i][j] * b.mat[j][l]) % MOD);
                    }
                }
            }
            return c;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        long n = sc.nextLong();
        int k = sc.nextInt();

        List<Integer> digits = new ArrayList<>();
        while (n > 0) {
            digits.add((int) (n % k));
            n /= k;
        }
        Collections.reverse(digits);

        int size = digits.size();

        Matrix[][] f = new Matrix[size + 1][k + 1];
        for (int i = 0; i <= size; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= k; j++) {
                f[i][j] = new Matrix();
            }
        }

        Matrix base = new Matrix();
        for (int i = 0; i <= k; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= k; j++) {
                if (i == j || i == 0 || j == 0) {
                    base.mat[i][j] = 1;
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < k; j++) {
                f[i + 1][j] = new Matrix();
                for (int r = 0; r <= k; r++) {
                    System.arraycopy(base.mat[r], 0, f[i + 1][j].mat[r], 0, k + 1);
                }
                f[i + 1][j].mat[j][j] = 1;
                f[i + 1][j].mat[0][j] = 1;
            }
        }

        Matrix[] prefix = new Matrix[size + 1];
        Matrix[] suffix = new Matrix[size + 1];

        prefix[0] = new Matrix();
        for (int r = 0; r <= k; r++) {
            System.arraycopy(base.mat[r], 0, prefix[0].mat[r], 0, k + 1);
        }

        suffix[size] = new Matrix();
        for (int r = 0; r <= k; r++) {
            System.arraycopy(base.mat[r], 0, suffix[size].mat[r], 0, k + 1);
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= size; i++) {
            prefix[i] = prefix[i - 1].mul(f[i][0], k);
        }

        for (int i = size - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
            suffix[i] = f[i + 1][0].mul(suffix[i + 1], k);
        }

        Matrix answer = new Matrix();
        answer.mat[0][k] = 1;
        int total = 0;

        for (int i = size - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
            for (int j = 0; j < digits.get(i); j++) {
                answer = answer.mul(f[i + 1][(total + j) % k], k);
            }
            total = (total + digits.get(i)) % MOD;
        }

        int res = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i <= k; i++) {
            res = (res + answer.mat[0][i]) % MOD;
        }
        System.out.println(res);
        sc.close();
    }
}
